<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916877_theRebbe_274__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the distinction between "ratzon" (external will) and "cheifetz" (inner will), and how the desire for the revelations of the chain of descent is only an external will, while the inner will is directed toward the Essence of Ein Sof.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="1">that this that is said, "and with You I did not desire"</t>
    <t s="2">(specifically "desire" [cheifatzti]),</t>
    <t s="3">is because the term "ratzon" (will) is</t>
    <t s="4">(also)</t>
    <t s="5">in the externality of will,</t>
    <t s="6">and even a will that comes through coercion is called "ratzon,"</t>
    <t s="7">like "they coerce</t>
    <t s="8">him until he says 'I want,'"</t>
    <t s="9">and "cheifetz" is the innerness of will.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is "and with You I did not desire,"</t>
    <t s="11">for will</t>
    <t s="12">(the externality of will)</t>
    <t s="13">He also has in the revelations of the order of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="14">but His "cheifetz"</t>
    <t s="15">(the innerness of will)</t>
    <t s="16">is in the Essence of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="17">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="18">that this that He has a will in the revelations of the order of the chain of descent is,</t>
    <t s="19">because just as from above to below,</t>
    <t s="20">the coming into being of this lowly world from the Essence is through the medium of the revelations,</t>
    <t s="21">including also the revelations of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="22">so too is it in the ascent from below to above,</t>
    <t s="23">that the ascent and inclusion in the Essence of Ein Sof is through the revelations of the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="24">and therefore He desires them.</t>
    <t s="25">But the will in them is the externality of will,</t>
    <t s="26">in order that through them He will reach the Essence of Ein Sof.</t>
    <t s="27">And to note,</t>
    <t s="28">that in many places</t>
    <t s="29">it is explained in the interpretation of the verse,</t>
    <t s="30">"For kindness I desire, and not sacrifice,"</t>
    <t s="31">that the "cheifetz,"</t>
    <t s="32">the innerness of will,</t>
    <t s="33">is that there be kindness,</t>
    <t s="34">a drawing down below,</t>
    <t s="35">and the will in sacrifice</t>
    <t s="36">(offerings),</t>
    <t s="37">an ascent from below to above,</t>
    <t s="38">is only the externality of will for the sake of the drawing down that is effected through the ascent.</t>
    <t s="39">And in this maamar it implies,</t>
    <t s="40">that the "cheifetz,"</t>
    <t s="41">the innerness of will</t>
    <t s="42">[of Israel,</t>
    <t s="43">and from this it is understood that it is so also above,</t>
    <t s="44">for Israel are the children of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="45">and the will of the son is the will of the father],</t>
    <t s="46">is also in the ascent from below to above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that although the love of "Who is like You in the heavens" and "with You I did not desire" is primarily in the G-dly soul, through prolonged contemplation the animal soul also agrees, and its inclusion in the flames of the G-dly soul draws a higher revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">2)</t>
    <t s="2">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="3">that although the love of "Who is like You in the heavens" and "with You I did not desire" is</t>
    <t s="4">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="5">in the G-dly soul,</t>
    <t s="6">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="7">through prolonged contemplation,</t>
    <t s="8">also the animal soul will agree to this.</t>
    <t s="9">For this is that after "Hear O Israel, the L-rd is our G-d, the L-rd is One" it says "And you shall love the L-rd your G-d with all your heart, with both your inclinations,"</t>
    <t s="10">that through the contemplation of the G-dly soul</t>
    <t s="11">("Hear O Israel")</t>
    <t s="12">on the matter of "One,"</t>
    <t s="13">"You are One and not in number,"</t>
    <t s="14">also the animal soul comes to this love.</t>
    <t s="15">And as the Admur</t>
    <t s="16">(the Rebbe Rashab)</t>
    <t s="17">of blessed memory explains in the continuation of 5666,</t>
    <t s="18">that through the G-dly soul understanding and grasping the concept of "Havayah is One,"</t>
    <t s="19">this also affects the animal soul that it will at least understand that it is necessary to say so,</t>
    <t s="20">even though the concept itself is not grasped by it.</t>
    <t s="21">And he adds</t>
    <t s="22">(in the continuation of 5666)</t>
    <t s="23">another matter,</t>
    <t s="24">that since the G-dly soul is vested in the animal soul,</t>
    <t s="25">therefore,</t>
    <t s="26">in the flames of fire of the G-dly soul, the animal soul is also burned and consumed.</t>
    <t s="27">And to add,</t>
    <t s="28">that through the animal soul being included in the flames of fire of the G-dly soul,</t>
    <t s="29">a revelation is drawn that is higher than the revelation drawn through the love of the G-dly soul.</t>
    <t s="30">And as explained in the continuation of the Hilula, that through the service of subjugation and transformation, the light that is in all worlds equally is drawn,</t>
    <t s="31">a light that is above relation to worlds.</t>
    <t s="32">[And to note,</t>
    <t s="33">that this matter is explained in that continuation also at the conclusion and seal of chapter two,</t>
    <t s="34">following what is explained there that the animal soul ascends and is included in the flames of fire of the G-dly soul].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section concludes that through our actions and service during the exile, the main dwelling of the Shechinah in the lower worlds is drawn even more than in the Holy Temple, and may it be fulfilled soon that the children of Israel go out with a high hand.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And through our actions and our service during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="1">that the main matter of subjugation and transformation is during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="2">the drawing down of the principal dwelling of the Shechinah in the lower worlds is made even more than it was in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="3">except that now it is in concealment, and the revelation of this drawing down will be in the future.</t>
    <t s="4">And may it be His will that very soon will be fulfilled what is stated in our portion,</t>
    <t s="5">"And the children of Israel went out with a high hand and with uncovered head,"</t>
    <t s="6">and that all this will be very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
